design: Freeze new64 context basis. Build a fixed response-weighted projection from the 64 old regular discovery positive small-dose input responses only. K=(A G A^T)^-1 A G where G=mean J_e^T J_e and J_e dc=T(dc,e). At evaluation coefficients are K dc; no new-case e or full target used for coefficients. Use actual new incoming e to execute the same bilinear map.
comparison: Full, unchanged, Euclidean projection, per-case oracle, fixed metric. Evaluate all H597 fresh cases. H597 outcomes motivated this follow-up, so this is adaptive evaluation, not a second independent confirmation.
scope: Fixed linear coefficient map, not an upstream context generator. Uses original model weights and discovery input responses to learn a metric; oracle remains diagnostic only. Float64 KL and linear solve.
